mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO gateway_audit_log (event_id, request_id, trace_id, user_id, username, client_ip, method, path, route_id, target_service, request_kind, status_code, user_agent, error_message, occurred_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{requestId}, #{traceId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{clientIp}, #{method}, #{path}, #{routeId}, #{targetService}, #{requestKind}, #{statusCode}, #{userAgent}, #{errorMessage}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN status_code BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN status_code BETWEEN 400 AND 499 THEN 'CLIENT_ERROR' WHEN status_code >= 500 THEN 'SERVER_ERROR' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM gateway_audit_log GROUP BY CASE WHEN status_code BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN status_code BETWEEN 400 AND 499 THEN 'CLIENT_ERROR' WHEN status_code >= 500 THEN 'SERVER_ERROR' ELSE 'OTHER' END
